about: Have the Ministry of Justice attest an official deed already attested by a government authority.
note: Requirements read from the official MOJ service page on the checked date. MOJ fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The page prints the fee without a currency, AED assumed. Attestation of official deeds. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Someone acting for the document holder needs a power of attorney
documents: The deed, already attested by the competent government authority
Power of attorney, if acting for the holder
fees: Unpaid applications are cancelled after 14 days
channels: eAttestation portal, register with UAE PASS first
